resources.string: Passenger-side lyrics in wide landscape. Showing or hiding the panel reconnects CarPlay to fit its new width.
Uses LRCLIB and LrcAPI without a Spotify login. Sends song title, artist, album and duration. This Android device needs its own internet connection.
Lyrics will appear in wide landscape. Rotate the device to show the panel.
